title: designmap v1 redesign accepted per spec milestones
requirement: Owner spec "Design Map — дизайн фичи v1": replace the geometry-drawing Excalidraw design map with a living document — semantic YAML model (immutable ids, zod) as source of truth, ELK deterministic layout, overlays for human visual edits that survive regeneration, a custom renderer panel in the DSH client (read-only by default, drill-down/search/legend/breadcrumb/stale badges), agent tools scan/apply/render/status/open/export with manifest-based stale detection, structured JSONL logs, SVG export — delivered as milestones M0 core, M1 read-only renderer, M2 edit mode, M3 living doc, M4 export+polish, with API tests before code (§12) and acceptance by log evidence.
reason: The requirement is a multi-milestone redesign (core package + client renderer + tools), so no single test file can encode it; each milestone is proven separately by the M0-M4 tasks with their own executable evidence, and this intake case is the traceable owner statement they answer to.
steps: Run the §12 API tests for elkjs, zod, yaml, @xyflow/react and the DSH client chunk transport before any feature code
M0: build designmap-core and prove determinism, refusal, empty model and lint per rule in Node
M1: render a scene read-only in a real browser with navigation, legend, breadcrumb and stale badges
M2: drag/recolour in edit mode, then regenerate and confirm overlays survive
M3: run status -> scan -> apply -> render -> lint on a real source edit and read every step in logs/*.jsonl
M4: export SVG in the current state, pack the plugin, document what was not verified
expected: Each milestone's acceptance is demonstrated by its own command output and logs: M0 byte-identical scene across runs and per-rule lint; M1 render.done with zero runtime errors; M2 merge.applied confirming saved positions after regeneration; M3 status logging staleNodes after a source edit; M4 SVG export from the current scene.
